notablePrerequisites: Liliana has at least three loyalty counters.
description:
Activate Liliana's third ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie cards from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Fleshbag Marauder either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Fleshbag Marauder enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and each other player to sacrifice a creature.
Repeat from step 2.
